asked.item: Per-clip credit costs for video models

verdict.reason: The AI Video Credits table lists the credit cost per video clip for each image-to-video model, and the Gemini Omni Flash models are priced per second.

steps.text: For AI image-to-video models, framepack costs 55 credits per video clip, and kling v1.5 and kling v1.6 each cost 210.
Luma dream machine costs 170 credits per video clip, runway gen3 costs 85, and minimax costs 170.
Google veo2 costs 835 credits per video clip, veo3 costs 1250, and veo3/fast costs 400.
Both google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1/text-to-video and google/gemini-omni-flash/v1.1/image-to-video cost 35/sec at 720p and 50/sec at 1080p.
